description:
Power, Control, and Confidence
The S8 Electric Bike is built for riders who demand strong performance, everyday reliability, and confident handling. Powered by a robust 1500W[Peak] motor and a high-capacity 48V 18.2Ah battery, the S8 delivers smooth acceleration and stable cruising for urban commuting and recreational riding alike.
With 20 × 4.0 inch wide tires, front and rear hydraulic disc brakes, and a durable chrome molybdenum steel frame, the S8 offers enhanced stability, braking confidence, and long-term durability across a variety of road conditions.

Why Choose the S8 Electric Bike?

750W High-Performance MotorProvides strong and responsive power delivery, making acceleration smoother and hill riding more manageable for daily commuting and leisure rides.

48V 18.2Ah High-Capacity BatteryDesigned to support longer rides with consistent power output, reducing the need for frequent charging during regular use.

Front & Rear Hydraulic Disc BrakesOffers reliable and precise braking performance, improving control and safety in both city traffic and varied road conditions.

20 × 4.0 Inch Wide TiresEnhances riding stability and comfort while improving grip on uneven surfaces such as city streets, gravel paths, and light off-road terrain.

Durable Chromoly Steel FrameBuilt with chrome molybdenum steel for added strength and long-term durability, suitable for riders who need a robust and dependable e-bike.

SHIMANO Gear System & Multiple Riding ModesCombines SHIMANO gear shifting with electric, pedal-assist, and manual riding modes to adapt easily to different riding preferences and conditions.

Who Is the S8 Electric Bike For?

Urban CommutersIdeal for riders looking for a powerful and stable electric bike to handle daily city travel with reduced physical effort.

Riders Seeking Extra PowerA great choice for those who prefer stronger motor assistance and confident acceleration compared to standard low-power e-bikes.

Comfort-Oriented RidersWide tires, stable geometry, and multiple riding modes make the S8 suitable for riders who prioritize comfort and control.

Heavier or Taller RidersWith a maximum load capacity of 330 lb, the S8 is designed to support a wider range of rider builds.

Everyday & Weekend RidersPerfect for commuting during the week and relaxed cruising on weekends without switching bikes.

Riding Modes
Pure Electric / Pedal Assist / Manual Pedaling
